evidence: In the heart of Hanoi's bustling Old Quarter, nestled beside the shimmering Hoan Kiem Lake, lies a cultural and spiritual gem that has been a beloved institution for generations: the Trang Tien Shop, also known as Cửa hàng Tràng Tiền. Established in 1958 during the subsidy period, this iconic ice cream parlor has been a staple of the city's culinary scene, adopting the name of the historic street it occupies, which was once the mint of the ancient imperial city.
